notes: Quarterly (9 months to 30 September 2025 = year to date). First IFRS 17 interim year (2567 comparatives restated). Dhipaya Life Assurance. CAR disclosure p.1-3, reviewed statements (EY) from p.4; scanned, read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). Baht, face and notes. No PAA business. SCI three months p.8, nine months p.10. Issued contracts are reported in two portfolio groups: note 7 (ordinary and others) and note 8 (credit group). Revenue and expenses from note 6 total column (p.51, nine months). CSM roll-forward = sum of the CSM columns of 7.2 (p.55) and 8.2 (p.60); new business = 7.3 (p.57) + 8.3 (p.62) totals. Each summed item records the note 7 page; the heading names the note 8 page. Future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column). Other revenue = รายการอื่น (note 6). Other expense = other operating expenses (no separate other finance cost line). The three-month profit or loss is the SCI for the three months to 30 September 2568 (p.8).
